text: Better Float 是面向 DSH Desktop 的界面浮动面板插件，可把常用区域提取到可移动、可缩放的面板中。它通过快捷键进入元素选择模式，用户可调整选区层级并确认；面板关闭时会尝试恢复原布局。浮窗管理器可查看已打开面板并重新摆放。插件优先移动真实 DOM 节点以保留交互，遇到不适合的结构会采用其他提取方式并给出提示。另有需本机 companion 配置的独立窗口预览，适合需要同时查看多个界面区域的 DSH Desktop 用户；普通面板不需要 API Key。

Better Float turns DSH Desktop regions into movable panels. Pick an element, adjust the selection, and confirm; closing a panel attempts restoration. An overview helps reposition panels. The optional separate-window preview needs a local companion and supports limited controls.

Better Float 的功能「用快捷键选择界面区域」：用户按选择快捷键后可用指针选中页面元素，并通过方向键或滚轮调整选区层级；确认后进入面板提取流程。
Better Float 的功能「创建可交互浮动面板」：确认选区后，插件将区域放入 DSH 内的面板；面板可移动和调整大小，关闭时调用提取结果的恢复逻辑。
Better Float 的功能「查看和重新摆放面板」：通过第二个快捷键切换面板总览，从缩略视图选择已打开的面板并指定新的摆放位置。
Better Float 的功能「请求独立窗口预览」：拖动选区到边缘可请求可选 companion 连接；插件先检查后端并显示确认步骤，再尝试呈现受支持的控件。
Better Float 使用独立窗口预览前需配置本机 Electron companion；连接会先询问用户确认，适配器只支持有限控件，文本输入值可能被传送。

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · @metaone01/dsh-better-float：把 DSH Desktop 中常用的界面区域变成可拖动、缩放的应用内浮动面板。

[English](./README.en.md) · [外部窗口提取（预览）](./docs/EXTERNAL-WINDOW-PREVIEW.md) · [开发说明](./docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) · [更新记录](./CHANGELOG.md)

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · 能做什么：- 用快捷键选择界面元素，通过滚轮或方向键调整选择范围。
- 将选区放入应用内面板，移动、缩放并继续操作；关闭面板时尝试放回原布局。
- 通过浮窗管理器浏览缩略图、找回面板并重新摆放。
- 随 DSH 切换中英文界面。
- **外部窗口提取为预览功能**：可选的本机 companion 为受支持的内容和控件提供独立窗口，需要额外配置，存在兼容性限制。

应用内面板优先移动真实 DOM 节点，以保留原有状态和交互。复杂编辑器、虚拟列表、iframe、Canvas、媒体和 Shadow DOM 仍可能出现样式或状态变化；请先在可恢复的区域尝试。
@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · 安装：这是 **DSH Desktop 插件**，需要提供插件管理功能及相关界面服务的 DSH Desktop。它不是独立桌面应用，也不是安装到任意网页的浏览器扩展。目前没有声明经过完整验证的最低 DSH 版本；出现服务缺失时请更新宿主并提供版本信息。

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · 使用维护者提供的安装包：发布前测试或离线安装时，可在支持本地包的 DSH 插件管理入口输入 `.tgz` 的绝对路径，例如：

```text
C:/Downloads/metaone01-dsh-better-float-0.1.1.tgz
```

这只安装插件包；外部窗口预览所需的 Electron 运行时和配对配置见[预览功能说明](./docs/EXTERNAL-WINDOW-PREVIEW.md)。无需为此包放宽 pnpm 的构建脚本权限。

如果此前安装过旧的裸包名版本，请先在 DSH 插件管理器移除旧插件，再安装 `@metaone01/dsh-better-float`，避免重复注册相同的快捷键。

text: @metaone01/dsh-better-float README · 卸载：先关闭浮动面板，再在 DSH 插件管理器中移除 `@metaone01/dsh-better-float`，退出并重启 Desktop。若曾手动配置外部窗口预览，还需按预览说明清理该插件的配置并停止手动启动的 companion。

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · 第一次使用：1. 按选择快捷键，将鼠标移到想浮动的区域上。
2. 用滚轮或 `↑` / `↓` 调整选中范围；点击、拖动后松开，或按 `Enter` 确认。按 `Esc` 取消。
3. 拖动面板标题栏移动，拖动右下角调整大小，点击面板使其置前。
4. 点击标题栏的 `✕`，尝试将真实控件恢复到原位置。建议在切换工作区或关闭原页面之前先恢复。

| 操作 | Windows / Linux | macOS |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 开始选择；再次按下取消 | `Ctrl+Shift+S` | `Cmd+Shift+S` |
| 打开／关闭浮窗管理器 | `Ctrl+Alt+Shift+S` | `Cmd+Option+Shift+S` |
| 调整选择层级 | `↑` / `↓` 或滚轮 | 同左 |
| 确认选择 | 点击、拖动后松开或 `Enter` | 同左 |
| 取消选择、管理器或放置 | `Esc` | 同左 |

快捷键表是默认绑定，不表示各平台均已完成真实宿主验收。
@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · 第一次使用：浮窗管理器采用**两步放置**：先点一个缩略图，再在目标位置点击一次确定面板左上角。在第二次点击之前按 `Esc` 可取消放置。

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · 常见问题：**安装提示 Git 依赖需要 `allowBuilds`？** 这是源码 Git 安装触发构建的路径。请改用 npm 版本号或维护者提供的预构建 `.tgz`，不要用 `github:metaone01/dsh-better-float` 作为普通用户安装入口。

**快捷键没有反应？** 完整重启 Desktop，检查插件是否启用、是否有快捷键冲突；先在没有模态对话框的普通页面区域尝试。仍无响应时，记录 DSH 和插件版本及启动错误。

**外部窗口提示未配置或不可用？** 这是可选预览功能，需要 Electron companion 和 Host 配对配置。普通应用内面板不依赖此功能；不要仅为了消除提示而修改全局构建权限。

**提取后样式变化或控件不能恢复？** 关闭面板尝试恢复；若源区域已被宿主替换，可能需要重新打开该区域或重启 Desktop。提交问题时说明选取的区域、主题、缩放和复现步骤，并遮盖截图中的敏感信息。

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · 反馈与开发：通过 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/metaone01/dsh-better-float/issues) 报告问题，附上 DSH 版本、插件版本、操作系统、复现步骤，以及是否使用了外部窗口预览。当前维护重点是 Windows；其他系统的外部窗口路径尚需单独验证。

源码构建、项目目录和打包方法见[开发说明](./docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)。历史调试记录保存在仓库的 `docs/history/`，不作为当前用户安装步骤，也不随 npm 包分发。

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · @metaone01/dsh-better-float：Turn frequently used regions of DSH Desktop into interactive, movable in-app panels.

[中文](./README.md) · [External window extraction (Preview)](./docs/EXTERNAL-WINDOW-PREVIEW.md) · [Development](./docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) · [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md)

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · Features：- Select a region with a shortcut, then adjust the selection with the mouse wheel or arrow keys.
- Move and resize in-app panels, keep interacting, and attempt restoration when closing a panel.
- Find and reposition panels using thumbnails in the floating panel manager.
- Follow DSH's Chinese or English interface language.
- **External window extraction is a preview feature.** An optional local companion displays supported content and controls in a separate window. It needs additional configuration and has compatibility limits.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · Features：In-app panels prefer moving the original DOM nodes to preserve state and interaction. Complex editors, virtual lists, iframes, Canvas, media and Shadow DOM can still lose styles or state. Start with a region you can safely reopen.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · Installation：This is a **DSH Desktop plugin**, requiring a host with plugin management and the relevant UI services. It is not a standalone desktop app or a general browser extension. A fully verified minimum DSH version has not been established. Update the host and include its version when reporting missing services.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · Install from npm：You do not need to clone the repository, install development dependencies or build the plugin. The published package runs no build on installation. DSH supplies React; do not install another copy for this plugin.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · Install a supplied package file：For testing before publication or offline installation, enter an absolute package path in a DSH plugin manager that supports local packages, for example:

```text
C:/Downloads/metaone01-dsh-better-float-0.1.1.tgz
```

This installs the plugin. The optional external window preview separately requires an Electron runtime and pairing configuration; see the [preview guide](./docs/EXTERNAL-WINDOW-PREVIEW.md). No pnpm build permission exception is required for this package.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · Install a supplied package file：If you previously installed the unscoped package, remove that old plugin in DSH before installing `@metaone01/dsh-better-float` to avoid duplicate shortcut registration.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · Uninstall：Close floating panels, remove `@metaone01/dsh-better-float` in DSH's plugin manager, then quit and restart Desktop. If you configured the preview manually, also remove this plugin's preview settings and stop any manually launched companion as described in the preview guide.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · First use：1. Press the selection shortcut and point to a region.
2. Adjust the scope with the wheel or `↑` / `↓`. Click, release a drag or press `Enter` to confirm. Press `Esc` to cancel.
3. Drag the title bar to move a panel; drag its lower-right corner to resize. Click to raise it.
4. Close with `✕` to attempt restoration. Restore panels before switching workspaces or closing the source page.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · First use：| Action | Windows / Linux | macOS |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Start selection; press again to cancel | `Ctrl+Shift+S` | `Cmd+Shift+S` |
| Toggle floating panel manager | `Ctrl+Alt+Shift+S` | `Cmd+Option+Shift+S` |
| Change selection level | `↑` / `↓` or wheel | Same |
| Confirm | Click, release a drag or `Enter` | Same |
| Cancel selection, manager or placement | `Esc` | Same |

These are default bindings, not a claim that every platform has passed live host acceptance.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · First use：The manager uses **two-step placement**: select a thumbnail, then click the destination for the panel's top-left corner. Press `Esc` before the second click to cancel placement.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · External window extraction (Preview)：**This feature is in preview. Installing the plugin does not configure a companion automatically.** The “Open external window (Preview)” button checks for a backend and requests confirmation for supported connections. Keep using the in-app panel if the backend is unconfigured, the selection is unsupported or connection fails.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · External window extraction (Preview)：The local companion displays adapted content and forwards explicitly supported operations to the source controls. It cannot reproduce arbitrary pages in another process. Limited adapters cover native buttons, text inputs, some workspace operations and DSH composer drafts. Menus, attachments and sending remain in Desktop.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · External window extraction (Preview)：A connection can transfer selected text and control values. Review your selection for private information before approving. See the [preview guide](./docs/EXTERNAL-WINDOW-PREVIEW.md) for setup, limits and shutdown instructions.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · Troubleshooting：**Git installation asks for `allowBuilds`.** Use a published npm version or a prebuilt `.tgz` instead of `github:metaone01/dsh-better-float`. Git source installation is not the recommended user distribution path.

**The shortcut does nothing.** Fully restart Desktop, check plugin enablement and shortcut conflicts, and try outside a modal dialog. Include host/plugin versions and startup errors in a report.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · Troubleshooting：**External windows are unconfigured or unavailable.** This optional preview needs an Electron companion and Host pairing configuration. In-app panels work independently. Do not change global build permissions just to clear this message.

**Styles change or restoration fails.** Close the panel to attempt restoration. If the host replaced the original region, reopen it or restart Desktop. Include the selected region, theme, scale and reproduction steps, and redact screenshots.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · Feedback and development：Report issues through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/metaone01/dsh-better-float/issues), including DSH version, plugin version, OS, reproduction steps and whether the external window preview was used. Current maintenance focuses on Windows; external windows on other systems need separate verification.

@metaone01/dsh-better-float README · Feedback and development：See [development instructions](./docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) for source builds, project structure and packaging. Historical diagnostics remain under `docs/history/` in the repository and are excluded from the npm package.
